title: 第3章 张逸风出手第4章 女神
content_zh:
赵龙是张逸风重生之后，唯一主动招呼他，并且将他当成同学而不是当成笑柄的人。看见赵龙被欺负，他好像看见了前段时间自己被欺负的样子。
但，现在的他，已经不是以前的他。
“妈的，又是谁这么有种。”
于超有些无语，什么时候经开大学的学生这么有种了？
转头一看，于超忽然笑了。
“我以为是谁呢，原来是名震经开大学，赫赫有名的张逸风大少爷啊。”
于超自然认识张逸风，张逸风还是少爷的时候，于超没少跟着张逸风一起吃喝玩乐。但张家落败之后，于超就同张逸风拉开了界限。
顿了顿，于超戏谑的道。
“对了，好像你家已经破产了，你只是一个**丝。还有，我是不是应该叫你张小萎？哈哈哈。张小萎，如果你想多管闲事，请你掂量一下自己的……（身份）”
于超一边说，一边笑，但他的话还没有说完，只听轰的一声响。他的身体像是一枚炮弹，直接倒飞出去，撞翻了一个桌子，身体才倒在地上。而他原本站着的地方，张逸风忽然出现在那里。
于超，自然是张逸风打飞的。
张小萎三个字，让张逸风根本无法忍耐自己的情绪，他右手猛然一拍桌子，身体借力而起，一个踢腿，直接将一百三十斤重的于超踢飞了。
这一幕，惊呆了现场所有人。张逸风刚才的动作，就像是拍电影一样，说起来简单，做起来就难了。
“超哥！”
两位跟班第一时间反应过来，连忙扶起于超。
“张小萎，你居然敢偷袭老子。”
于超愤怒不已，眼神中充满怒意。
“你叫我什么，再叫一次。”
张逸风冷淡的声音传来。
“妈的，你还以为你是以前的张少？老子叫你张小萎，怎么……（了）”

于超非常嚣张，但他的话还没有说完，身体再次飞了出去。这一次，张逸风一个回旋踢，将他踢飞了！
这一次比上一次还用力，于超躺在地上，再也站不起来，他的肋骨断了两根，嘴角也溢出一抹鲜血。
这一幕，再次惊呆了所有人，不少人已经开始小声议论。
“这……这真的是张逸风吗？消沉了几个月，他怎么变得这么厉害了！”
“是啊，刚才张逸风的动作真帅，要不是现在家破人亡，人家都想让他当我男朋友呢。”
“你犯花痴啊，他可是阳……萎呢。哎，可惜了这一副好皮囊。说起来真是奇怪，我觉得张逸风比以前更有男人味了，身体也强壮了不少。”
“厉害？强壮？我觉得你们还是替他的未来担忧一下吧，知道他是怎么萎的吗？他是得罪了东区的混混头目肖兵。才被打成了阳痿。而于超，就是肖冰的手下……”
“什么，还有这事情？完了，张逸风肯定完了。”
这些议论，张逸风听见了一些，但他却毫不在意，因为他本来就打算找当初那一群混混的麻烦。
content_en:
Zhao Long was the only person who took the initiative to greet Zhang Yifeng after his rebirth and treated him as a classmate instead of a laughingstock. Seeing Zhao Long being bullied, he seemed to have seen himself being bullied some time ago.
But, the person he is now is no longer the person he used to be.
"Damn it, who is so talented?"
Yu Chao was a little speechless. When did the students at Jingkai University become so talented?
Looking back, Yu Chao suddenly smiled.
"Who did I think it was? It turned out to be the famous young master Zhang Yifeng from the Kaikai University of Economics."
Yu Chao met Zhang Yifeng. When Zhang Yifeng was still a young master, Yu Chao often ate, drank and had fun with Zhang Yifeng. But after the Zhang family was defeated, Yu Chao distanced himself from Zhang Yifeng.
After a pause, Yu Chao said jokingly.
"By the way, it seems that your family has gone bankrupt and you are just a prostitute. Also, should I call you Zhang Xiaowei? Hahaha. Zhang Xiaowei, if you want to meddle in others' affairs, please consider your... (identity)"
Yu Chao laughed as he spoke, but before he finished speaking, he only heard a bang. His body was like a cannonball, flying backwards and knocking over a table before his body fell to the ground. And where he was originally standing, Zhang Yifeng suddenly appeared there.
Yu Chao was naturally beaten away by Zhang Yifeng.
The words "Zhang Xiaowei" made Zhang Yifeng unable to bear his emotions at all. He slammed his right hand on the table, used the force of his body to rise up, and kicked Yu Chao, who weighed 130 kilograms, away.
This scene shocked everyone present. Zhang Yifeng's actions just now were like filming a movie. It's easy to say but difficult to do.
"Brother Chao!"
The two followers reacted immediately and quickly helped Yu Chao up.
"Zhang Xiaowei, how dare you sneak up on me."
Yu Chao was furious, his eyes full of anger.
"What did you call me? Call me again."
Zhang Yifeng's cold voice came.
"Damn it, you still think you are the old Mr. Zhang? I call you Zhang Xiaowei, why..."
Yu Chao was very arrogant, but before he finished speaking, his body flew out again. This time, Zhang Yifeng kicked him away with a roundhouse kick!
This time it was harder than the last time. Yu Chao lay on the ground and could no longer stand up. Two of his ribs were broken, and a trace of blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.
This scene once again shocked everyone, and many people began to whisper.
"This...is this really Zhang Yifeng? How did he become so powerful after being depressed for several months!"
"Yeah, Zhang Yifeng's moves just now were so cool. If his family hadn't been ruined now, everyone would have wanted him to be my boyfriend."
"You are a nymphomaniac. He is impotent. Oh, it's a pity that he has such a good skin. It's really strange to say that I think Zhang Yifeng is more masculine than before, and his body is also much stronger."
"Awesome? Strong? I think you should worry about his future. Do you know how he became weak? He was beaten to impotence because he offended Xiao Bing, the gangster leader in the East District. And Yu Chao is Xiao Bing's subordinate..."
"What, this is still happening? It's over, Zhang Yifeng is definitely over."
Zhang Yifeng heard some of these discussions, but he didn't care because he originally planned to cause trouble for the gangsters.
